reason: The F-centred cubic cell (a approximately 10.5087 angstrom) and average diffraction fingerprint are well supported, but the submitted exact structure is not. The CIF is a 32-atom, Z=4 P1 expansion that symmetry-recovers as F-43m and has a calculated density of only 3.289 g/cm3, despite the trace itself identifying the doubled zincblende-derived cell as Z=8/64 atoms and rejecting a 32-atom toy model on connectivity grounds. Direct inspection confirms that four of eight Cu atoms and all four Sn atoms have no S neighbour within 4 angstrom (nearest Sn-S approximately 4.37 angstrom), while each S has only two nearby cations, so the submitted framework is chemically implausible. Validation used extracted intensities with a custom scale/displacement fit, not a supplied comparable whole-pattern Rwp, and it did not comprehensively instantiate and refine chemically complete 64-atom orderings or lower-symmetry alternatives. A materially different, physically complete structure can plausibly retain the established cell and improve the candidate set.
